probe.question: What is the minimum self-local immutable predecessor chain sufficient to reconstruct a missing or stale neuroscience LATEST checkpoint without other-role/shared-ledger semantics, while preserving exact authority provenance and avoiding duplicate logical advance?

objects: one immutable terminal neuroscience receipt that binds exact phase/root/task authority, the probe artifact blob, and the resulting committed LATEST blob
the immutable probe artifact referenced by that receipt, containing a self-contained reconstruction capsule with nonempty continuation and predecessor identity
not_required_for_reconstruction: recursive predecessor artifact traversal when the bound artifact contains a complete reconstruction capsule
the preflight artifact, which remains audit evidence only
minimum_reconstruction_chain.discovery_requirement: When LATEST is absent, the runtime must still be able to enumerate or search the own immutable neuroscience receipt namespace and identify the newest valid terminal receipt; ambiguity in that discovery is an unresolved child, not permission to guess.

reconstruction_capsule.exact_next_action: On the next valid invocation, test one self-local terminal-receipt discovery rule under receipt-list truncation or ordering ambiguity: require an immutable terminal receipt to bind artifact blob plus resulting LATEST blob, define a deterministic newest-valid tie-break using only own receipt/artifact metadata and repository ancestry exposed by lightweight transport, persist/read back, and stop without a second leaf.

missing_pointer.precondition: LATEST unreadable/absent; terminal receipt and bound artifact are valid and authority-identical
missing_pointer.action: materialize the canonical reconstruction capsule as pointer state; this is restoration of an already-committed checkpoint, not a new logical advance
missing_pointer.duplicate_recovery_behavior: same canonical target is recognized; no second logical advance

stale_pointer.precondition: LATEST exists at an older bound predecessor while a newer valid terminal receipt binds the committed successor capsule
stale_pointer.action: CAS-replace only the stale pointer with the canonical committed capsule; do not replay the completed logical effect
stale_pointer.duplicate_recovery_behavior: same canonical target is recognized; no second logical advance

negative_control.condition: any phase/root/task or frozen root/config identity mismatch, receipt-artifact blob mismatch, or empty continuation

result.scope: Deterministic formal model over one valid missing-pointer branch, one valid stale-pointer branch, and authority-mismatch negative controls. No live deletion/corruption of LATEST and no concurrent writer were injected.
result.falsified_failure_mode: A missing or stale pointer does not require blind replay or recursive traversal when a terminal own receipt certifies a self-contained immutable artifact; recovery can restore checkpoint state with zero logical advance.
result.remaining_child: How to identify the newest valid terminal neuroscience receipt when LATEST is missing and receipt listing is truncated, unordered, or contains an acknowledged-lost tail remains untested.

exact_continuation: On the next valid invocation, test one self-local terminal-receipt discovery rule under receipt-list truncation or ordering ambiguity: require an immutable terminal receipt to bind artifact blob plus resulting LATEST blob, define a deterministic newest-valid tie-break using only own receipt/artifact metadata and repository ancestry exposed by lightweight transport, persist/read back, and stop without a second leaf.
